limitations: Recorded observations are advisory declarations, not an automated assessment of lesson meaning or problem difficulty.
The tool does not open sources or verify their official status, quotations, locations, truth, or currentness.
Artifact paths and declared SHA-256 values are not read or verified against file bytes.
Reviewer identity and independence are reported declarations and are not authenticated.
Assessment-format counts are recorded observations; they are not extracted from the lesson.
It does not establish learner achievement, equivalence to middle-school past problems, or completeness of competition coverage.
This report is independent of K01–K16 and does not change any earlier quality evaluation.
Only the two pinned KOAI 2026 example URLs have a fixed metadata consistency check; it does not fetch or authenticate them.
Only explicitly declared demands, roles, direct edges and local files are checked; undeclared learning requirements are not discovered.
Role labels, provenance locators, revision/origin claims and assessment support conditions are declarations, not semantic verification.
Current SHA-256 bindings establish local byte equality, not source authenticity, official status, truth or educational adequacy.
Reviewer independence, unaided learner performance, timing, execution and contest readiness are not checked.
This opt-in report is advisory and does not change the legacy structural validator or any earlier quality evaluation.

limits: No work, review, state update, publication or scheduling is executed.
Matching bytes and declarations do not establish semantic adequacy, consent, independent judgment or learner outcomes.
Declared local provenance and every local source catalog entry are checked; external source truth, pathless manifests and omitted dependencies remain unverified.
